name: Howard Kershner

summary.text: Howard E. Kershner (1891–1990) launched the Christian Freedom Foundation in 1950, served as its president and edited its newsletter Christian Economics for most of its 25 years; his 1957 book God, Gold, and Government grew out of lectures at Fuller Theological Seminary.
